regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-linked Non Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Single Premium Unit-Linked savings plan with up to 99.5% Premium allocation (Single Premium of Rs 10 lacs and above)
Loyalty Additions (up to 5.6% of Single Premium) added to the Single Premium Fund Value at maturity, depending on Single Premium amount and policy term
Maturity Benefit = Single Premium Fund Value plus Top-Up Premium Fund Value, if any, payable on survival to maturity
Death Benefit (subject to Guaranteed Death Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid) payable as lump sum to nominee
Choice of multiple investment funds under an Investor Selectable Portfolio Strategy
Partial withdrawals (after 5-year lock-in), Systematic Partial Withdrawal, fund switching, top-up premiums and Systematic Switching Option
Option to take death and maturity benefit in instalments (Settlement Option, up to 5 years)
riders_available: Bajaj Life Linked New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (UIN 116A060V01)

eligibility.note: Eligibility table (entry/maturity ages, sum-assured and term ranges) not recovered from this brochure parse; brochure states minimum/maximum premium and maximum Sum Assured are per Board Approved Underwriting Policy. Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document (except policies with tenure of less than a year); unit repurchase at price on cancellation date plus proportionate risk premium / medical / stamp duty deductions apply.
key_terms.grace_period: Not specified in brochure for this single-premium ULIP (single premium has no recurring premium due).
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death due to suicide within 12 months from date of commencement of policy, nominee receives the Single Premium Fund Value plus Top-Up Premium Fund Value as on date of intimation of death; any charges other than FMC/guarantee charge recovered after death are added back. No other death exclusion.
key_terms.lock_in_period: 5-year lock-in; surrender during lock-in moves value (less discontinuance charge) to the Discontinued Life Policy Fund, available as surrender value at end of lock-in.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws as amended from time to time'; consult a tax consultant. GST per prevailing tax laws.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Risks of Investment in the Units (ULIP market-risk statement: funds do not offer guaranteed/assured return; name of plan/funds does not indicate quality, future prospects or returns)

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'up to 99.5% premium allocation' claim is condition-bound — applies only to Single Premium of Rs 10 lacs and above; must be qualified.

Loyalty Additions (up to 5.6% of Single Premium) depend on the Single Premium amount and policy term chosen, are added only at maturity, and are NOT payable on any Top-up premium — must be qualified, not stated as a flat guaranteed bonus.
Any maturity-value figure is the Fund Value (market-linked, non-guaranteed); only the 105% Guaranteed Death Benefit floor on death is guaranteed.
Partial withdrawals are allowed only after the 5-year lock-in and subject to stated limits.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'assured returns' / 'bonus' language — this is a non-participating unit-linked plan; returns are market-linked and not guaranteed (only the 105%-of-premiums death-benefit floor is guaranteed).
Do NOT present illustrative 4%/8% returns as expected or guaranteed — they are illustrative only and do not indicate upper/lower limits.
Do NOT omit the ULIP market-risk disclosure or the 5-year lock-in when positioning this as an investment/wealth product.
Do NOT imply the plan name or fund names indicate quality, future prospects or returns.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-linked Non Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan'

ULIP market-risk disclosure: 'Investment in ULIPs is subject to risks associated with the capital markets; the policyholder is solely responsible for his/her decisions; the unit price may go up or down based on fund performance'
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions
